# coval_test_set (Resource)

Manages a Coval test set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coval_test_set" "support" {
  display_name  = "Customer Support Scenarios"
  description   = "Scenarios managed by Terraform"
  test_set_type = "SCENARIO"

  test_set_metadata = {
    category = "support"
    priority = "high"
  }

  parameters = {
    customer_name = ["Alice", "Bob"]
    issue_type    = ["billing", "technical"]
  }

  tags = ["regression", "voice"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable test-set name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Test-set description.
- `parameters` (Dynamic) JSON object mapping parameter names to value arrays. Set {} to clear it.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly identifier. Coval derives it from display_name when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags associated with the test set. Set [] to clear them.
- `test_set_metadata` (Dynamic) Arbitrary JSON object containing additional test-set configuration. Set {} to clear it.
- `test_set_type` (String) Test-set type, such as DEFAULT, SCENARIO, TRANSCRIPT, or WORKFLOW.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned test-set ID.
- `name` (String) Canonical API resource name.
- `test_case_count` (Number) Number of active test cases in the test set.
- `update_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the latest update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = coval_test_set.support
  identity = {
    id = "abc12345"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String)

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coval_test_set.support abc12345
```
